sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Learned HCGP on instructions would submit that the charges have been framed and the petition would not be entertainable at this juncture.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that there is nothing that would become ingredients of Section 498A of the IPC against accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 in particular.
3. The concerned Court shall consider this aspect as well bearing in mind the observations made by the Apex Court or this Court in plethora of cases.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the petition and avail of remedy insofar as accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 are concerned.

5. In the light of the charges being framed, the entertainment of the petition will run foul of the judgment of NC: 2026:KHC:12819 HC-KAR the Apex Court in the case of MINAKSHI BALA V.
SUDHIR KUMAR1.
6.
Reserving liberty to the petitioners to avail of such remedy, as is available in law, the petition stands disposed.
All contentions are permitted to be urged before the concerned Court.
I.A.No.1/2026 is disposed as a consequence.

Sd/-
